rules.heading: Who reads what
rules.help: Each rule decides, for the discussions in its tags, which groups read everything. Everyone else reads the first posts, with the media you choose locked, and a preview of the rest, or none. A discussion follows the first rule naming one of its tags, or naming no tags. Admins and authors always read in full. With no rules, nothing is held back.
rules.empty: No rules. Nothing is held back from anyone.
rules.title: Rule {number}
rules.tags_help: The discussions this rule covers. None picked means every discussion.
rules.readers_help: Members means everyone signed in with a confirmed email. Untick it and pick groups to keep these tags for those groups.
rules.freePosts_help: How many posts at the start of each discussion everyone reads, 1 being the first post.
rules.preview_help: How many characters of each later post everyone else sees, 0 to show none.
rules.lock_help: Replaced by a prompt for everyone else. To hide links too, pair this with Guest CTA (ramon/guest-cta).
rules.upgrade_help: Where members outside these groups go to join one: a page on this forum (/subscriptions) or a full address.

meter.heading: Free discussions for guests
meter.enabled: Limit how many discussions a guest reads
meter.enabled_help: After the limit, a guest sees the start of the first post and a prompt to sign up. Discussions they already opened stay free until the period ends. Counted in a cookie, so a guest who clears theirs starts again, as on any metered site.
meter.period_help: Google suggests a month to start with.
meter.warn: Warn when this many are left
meter.warn_help: A notice says how many free discussions are left. 0 to never warn.
meter.lead_in_help: How many characters of the first post a guest still sees. 0 for none.
meter.by_ip_help: Catches visitors who clear or refuse cookies. People sharing one address (an office, a school, a mobile network) share one allowance, and with search engines turned off below, a crawler would be counted too. Only a keyed hash of the address is kept, for the period.
meter.exempt_help: Discussions in these tags are never counted.

crawlers.heading: Search engines
crawlers.enabled: Let search engines read gated content
crawlers.help: Google, Bing, Apple, Yandex and Baidu crawlers, proved by DNS (never by user agent alone), read everything and index it, with the paywall structured data Google asks for (isAccessibleForFree), so it isn't cloaking. Turn it off and they see what guests see: your SEO keeps only the free posts.
